Individually released Portraits for my SVE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46444]Portrait Pack[/url] (REQUIRED). You must follow the installation instructions on my original mod.

I plan on trying to finish my SVE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46444]Portrait Pack[/url] by early June and instead of pushing a million updates to the original mod and spamming people's SMAPI update logs every few days, I'll upload portraits as I complete them individually. Once I am finished or at least have a handful of new NPCs done I'll update my main mod with the complete pack.

[b]Installation Instructions[/b]
Files are PNGs, drag and drop into "Stardew Valley > Mods > [P] YolkiesPixelPortrait"
